integrity: The mathematical theorem has an analytic proof and a self-contained exact-rational checker; optional numerical LP benchmarking is supplementary. Only self-review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All parties have equal entitlements, exactly two residual seats, and a fixed arbitrary rank tie order; anonymity is not assumed except in the comparison benchmark. No claim for alternative tie policies or other residual seat totals.
title: Unique risk-minimizing two-seat apportionment and an exact parity law
